technical-summary: A cmake --build whose compiler dies from a signal (clang 'unable to execute command: Segmentation fault', gcc 'internal compiler error: <signal>', 'Killed signal terminated program') is run once more; a real compile error, an interrupt and every other command are never retried. Each crash and its retry is recorded as a JSON line (unit, signal, attempt, result) in bigcherry-compile-retries.jsonl in the build directory and in <work-root>/build-compile-retries.jsonl so the flake rate can be counted over time. The build output is passed through unchanged and the reuse-guarding build metadata file is not modified.
user-summary-candidate: Builds now retry once when the compiler randomly crashes, and record every such crash.
